question: Who among the following received the National Film Award in the Best Choreography category for the film ‘Bajirao Mastani’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Remo D’Souza**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Remo D’Souza** won the **National Award for Best Choreography for the Deewani Mastani song of Bajirao Mastani** in the **63rd National Film Award 2016**.
 
• The National Film Awards are offered annually by the Directorate of Film Festivals, the organization set up by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting,
 
• **Best Feature Film** - Bahubali- The Beginning
 
• **Dadasahb Phalke Award** - Manoj Kumar

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Film Awards**__

 __
 
• **​**__The Awards were first presented in **1954**.
 
• Dadasaheb Phalke Award, India's highest award in cinema, is presented under the National Film Awards.
 
• **Devika Rani **was the first recipient of the Dadasahab Phalke Award in **1969**.
 
 
 
• **68th National Film Awards 2020**
 
 
• **Asha Parikh** was awarded the Dadasahab Phalke Award.
 
• **Best Feature Film **- Soorarai Pottru
 
• **Best Book** - The Longest Kiss
 
• **Best Actor** - Suriya and Ajay Devgan.
